embed.description:

rules to prevent any types of punishments!*__

<:discord:1562469215741550664> **DISCORD RULES**

- No unnecessary pings to staff members
- Respectful behavior towards staff & other users
- No discrimination, racism or hate speech
- No NSFW, sexual, self-harm or drug-related topics
- No jokes about race, sexuality or gender
- No spamming or flooding in chat
- No scam links
- No inappropriate avatars, usernames or statuses
- No sharing personal data, not even your own
- No DDoS, DoX or raid threats (we take this seriously)
- No punishment evading**

<:red_X:1562468884874006528> **IN-GAME RULES**
**- Respectful behavior towards staff & other players
- No discrimination, racism or hate speech
- No spamming or advertising in chat
- No hacked, cheat clients or unfair modifications
- No exploiting or duping of any kind
- No IRL trading or cross-trading
- No DDoS or DoX threats of any kind

- Auto Reconnect is ALLOWED**

embed.title: <:HXSMP:1562471548445659276> WELCOME TO GATEMC
embed.description:
__*The #1 Factory Tycoon. Build your factory, grow your belt, guard your gate and raid everyone else!*__

<:fire:1562469845365166111> **YOUR FACTORY**
**- Every player gets a factory with a conveyor belt
- Upgrade your generator, belt speed and belt length
- Buy machines that multiply what your belt sells
- `/rebirth` for a permanent sale bonus and start again stronger**

<:crystal:1562469495245901874> **RAID & DEFEND**
**- Open gates can be raided: grab a Raid Pick with `/gear`
- Close your gate with `/gate` and build turrets, traps and armour in `/defence`
- `/trust` friends so they can come in without raiding you
- Cloak, lockpicks and powers for the bold**

<:money:1562469633611796571> **TOKENS & POWERS**
**- Tokens and caches drop off your belt
- Spend tokens on powers, managers and upgrades
- Hatch and level pets that boost your factory**

<:gift:1562469369991135282> **FREE REWARDS**
**- `/daily` rewards and `/tasks` every day
- Weekly leaderboards with prizes
- Random events and the travelling merchant**

<:store:1562469154559098881> **SUPPORT THE SERVER**
**- Ranks, credits and super powers at https://store.gatemc.org**

embed.title: <:server:1562469780622020638> HOW TO JOIN GATEMC
embed.description:
__*Hop on and play! GateMC supports both Java and Bedrock Edition.*__

<:crystal:1562469495245901874> **JAVA EDITION**
**- Open Minecraft and click Multiplayer
- Click Add Server
- Server Address: `play.gatemc.org`
- Click Done, then join!**
*Minecraft 1.21.5 or newer. Latest version recommended.*

<:bedrock:1562469015270723634> **BEDROCK EDITION**
**- Open Minecraft and go to Play, then Servers
- Scroll down and tap Add Server
- Server Address: `play.gatemc.org`
- Port: `19132`
- Tap Save, then join!**
*Works on mobile, Windows and Xbox. On PlayStation or Switch, ask in tickets for help.*

<:green_tick:1562468689515774003> **AFTER YOU JOIN**
**- Read the rules in <#1562533932002451466>
- Open `/menu` to find everything
- Claim `/daily` for free rewards**

<:wrench:1562468972593414298> Can't connect? Open a ticket in <#1562533962293706779>.
